investigator: fresh oracle subagent (no knowledge of the change under test)

evidence_tree.built_with: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>

step_1_wiki_effect.text: Carve: 6% armor reduction per stack, up to 5 stacks, 30% at 5 stacks; stack duration 6 s; applied by dealing physical damage to an enemy champion.

step_2_engine_average_stack_model.quoted_rule: docs/math-foundations.md 2.3(2): 'Black Cleaver average stacks (ArmorReductionEffect.average_reduction): the established model uses a fixed 0.8 * max_stacks constant (with a hits/2 short-fight branch)'
step_2_engine_average_stack_model.derivation: average stacks = 0.8 x 5 = 4.0 -> reduction fraction = 4.0 x 6% = 24% = 0.2400

quoted_rules: docs/math-foundations.md 2.2: reduce_resistance(R, r_flat, r_pct): R <- R - r_flat; R <- R * (1 - r_pct/100)
step_3_damage_factor.derivation: amplification from a 24% armor reduction on armor A = m(0.76A)/m(A) = (100 + A) / (100 + 0.76A). Setting this equal to 1.15 gives A = 15/0.126 = 119.05; any A in [111.7, 126.8] rounds to 1.15 (e.g. an unitemized level-18 champion target such as Aatrox, armor 119.6 -> 1.1504).
step_3_damage_factor.result: factor = 1.15 is internally consistent with fraction 0.24 against a realistic level-18/20 champion target armor (~112-127). The pair (0.24, 1.15) is coherent; neither number is fabricated.

candidate_justifications_tested.candidate: the 6 s Carve window lapsed before event[35]
candidate_justifications_tested.why: docs/math-foundations.md 2.3(2) states explicitly: 'The stack duration (6 s) is always longer than the engine's inter-swing interval for any realistic AS*u > 1/6, so expiry does not rescue the constant.' In a continuous roster fight the debuff is live.

candidate_justifications_tested.candidate: the reduction is attacker-specific, so a roster member who does not own Black Cleaver cannot benefit from it
candidate_justifications_tested.why: Carve is a debuff on the TARGET, not on the attacker. Cached in-game tooltip (data/items.json items['3071'].riotDescription): 'Dealing physical damage to champions reduces the target's Armor by 6% for 6 seconds. (stacks 5 times).' The engine's own split mirrors this: reduce_resistance mutates the target's R (docs/math-foundations.md 2.2), while apply_armor_penetration is the attacker-side half. A shredded target is shredded for every ally's physical damage.

candidate_justifications_tested.candidate: Bloodsong supplies the effect instead, making the Cleaver entry redundant
candidate_justifications_tested.why: Bloodsong (data/items.json items['3877'].passives[0]) grants Spellblade + 'Expose Weakness ... causing them to take 8%/5% increased damage from all sources' — an incoming-damage amplifier, not an armor_reduction_percent. It cannot substitute for or absorb the Carve reduction record.

candidate_justifications_tested.candidate: the removed entry duplicated another Carve entry earlier in the same list (per-target 30%/5-stack cap is shared across all appliers)
candidate_justifications_tested.verdict: NOT REFUTABLE FROM THIS EVIDENCE TREE — the sibling entries [0..2] live in scripts/golden_baseline.json, which the runbook forbids reading. This is the single falsifier of the verdict below: if a sibling entry in the same list already carried source 'Black Cleaver — Carve', then removing the second copy would be correct (the wiki caps the target debuff at 30% / 5 stacks no matter how many roster members apply it). Absent that duplicate, removal drops a real reduction.

step_4_can_absence_be_derived.conclusion: The value 0.24 (and its 1.15 companion factor) is fully derivable from the cached wiki text plus the quoted engine formulas. Absence is derivable from nothing in the cached sources; every rule-based justification for dropping the entry that the sources can speak to is refuted.

sources_quoted.quote: Dealing {{as|physical damage}} to an enemy champion applies a stack of ''Carve'' for 6 seconds, stacking up to 5 times. Each stack inflicts {{as|6% armor reduction}}, up to {{as|30%|armor}} at 5 stacks.
Dealing physical damage to champions reduces the target's Armor by 6% for 6 seconds. (stacks 5 times).

After using an ability, your next basic attack within 10 seconds deals 100% base AD bonus physical damage on-hit. If the target is a champion, inflict them with ''Expose Weakness'' for 4 seconds, causing them to take 8%/5% increased damage from all sources (1.5 second cooldown ...).

the established model uses a fixed 0.8 * max_stacks constant (with a hits/2 short-fight branch) ... The stack duration (6 s) is always longer than the engine's inter-swing interval for any realistic AS*u > 1/6, so expiry does not rescue the constant

m(R) = 100 / (100 + R) (apply_resistance, resistance.py) ... reduce_resistance(R, r_flat, r_pct): R <- R - r_flat; R <- R * (1 - r_pct/100) [flat first, then %] ... apply_{armor,magic}_penetration(R, f, p): R <- max(0, R*(1-p) - f)

sources_quoted.locator: stats.armor for level-18 champions, via base + growth*(L-1)*(0.7025 + 0.0175*(L-1))
sources_quoted.quote: Aatrox armor at level 18 = 119.6 -> (100+119.6)/(100+0.76*119.6) = 1.1504, i.e. the recorded factor 1.15

verdict_rationale: Black Cleaver's Carve is a target-side armor debuff (cached wiki text: 'reduces the target's Armor by 6% ... stacks 5 times'), so it applies to every physical-damage source against that target for the whole 6 s window, which docs/math-foundations.md says never lapses inside a continuous fight. The removed entry's numbers reproduce exactly from the sources (0.8 x 5 stacks x 6% = 0.24; (100+A)/(100+0.76A) = 1.15 at A ~ 119). Nothing in data/ or docs/math-foundations.md derives the absence. Verdict is conditional on the one hypothesis this evidence tree cannot test: if entries [0..2] of the same list already contain a 'Black Cleaver — Carve' record, the removal is a correct de-duplication (shared 5-stack / 30% cap) and the verdict flips to new_value_correct — an inspector with access to the sibling entries should check that first.
